private_logic_inspected_for_case_selecti.finding: The week-start boundary is cached by first weekday, week-one rule, and year; it also has separate jan and weekday-rule paths. The probe reaches this logic only through the public week-count method.
The public method has a cached-return path and otherwise derives the count from this-year and next-year starts. Repeated reads and the A-B-A rule sequence target those observable distinctions.
FirstDay and Week1ofYear have distinct validation paths. Values 8 and jan8 select one rejection from each path.

fixture_review.applied_entries: Every oo configuration entry except ForceDate, in original order.
fixture_review.reason_force_date_is_omitted: The directly constructed Base service has no timezone service, and the count operation has no clock input. The omission is explicit in every observation rather than hidden by the probe.

branch_evidence: The first read and same-key repeated reads have identical count values; unsupported empty, text, omitted, and absent inputs have fewer warnings after the first read.
Changing Week1ofYear jan4 to jan1 and back to jan4 on one service yields 52, 53, 52 for year 2000.
Invalid FirstDay 8 and Week1ofYear jan8 requests warn and leave the following year-2000 count at 52.
Year 9999 returns 52 even though the public implementation requests the next year's boundary internally.
completion: The public binding and these selected paths are reviewed. This does not prove all branches or approve the draft as an executable harness.
